name: The Return to Freddy's 3
storyline: A new entertainment is close to opening its doors and reveal the legend from the past. They only have a few more things to salvage before it officially opens. The new entertainment is to be called Fazbear Fantasy Land.
summary: The Return To Freddy's 3 is the third installment in the TRTF Saga. The game is the first sequel in the series, even though it's confusingly set in the same year as The Return To Freddy's Classic. The next game in the series is The Return To Freddy's 4.
